meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Who decided to give Owen a zero, and did anyone speak to him first?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me. Who decided on the zero, Hale, and when?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm not here to advise you, Hale. Withdraw the zero, or tell me who decided on it.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why did Owen find out from a gradebook on his phone, in the middle of class? Who decided on the zero, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a straight answer on who decided to enter it and whether anyone spoke to Owen first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and to know who decided on it.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "how I should handle this", because asking her to do your job gave her no evidence and made her respect you less.
Try next time: when she asks who decided on the zero and whether anyone spoke to Owen first, answer that directly, own entering it before calling home in one sentence, and put a dated document in front of her.
